title: AddaTipSmp
description: TIP SMP is a fast-paced custom SMP plugin that adds 21 unique TIPs with skill-based PvP abilities, strict cooldowns, and cinematic ultimate powers.
body:
# ⚡ TIP SMP – Custom Ability SMP Plugin

TIP SMP is a unique high-action SMP/PvP plugin designed to completely change normal Minecraft combat.

Every player receives a special “TIP”, and each TIP has its own fighting style, abilities, and ultimate power. 
Abilities are activated using simple mouse actions, making combat fast, skill-based, and cinematic.

🎮 Ability Controls
• Right Click → Small Ability
• Left Click → Secondary Ability
• Shift + Right Click → Ultimate Ability

⏱️ Anti-Spam Cooldown System
• Small Ability: 5s
• Secondary Ability: 5s
• Ultimate Ability: 20s
• Per-player & per-ability cooldowns
• Cooldowns do NOT reset on death

⚡ TIP System
• 20 Main TIPs
• 1 Bonus TIP (Meteor TIP)
• Total: 21 unique TIPs
Each TIP offers a completely different PvP experience.

🔥 Ultimate Abilities (Examples)
• One-hit Netherite kill
• Time stop
• Inventory steal
• God mode
• Area wipe (Meteor)

🛡️ Fair Gameplay
• No ability spam
• Safe-zone protection
• Combat-only ability usage
• Clear cooldown messages (ActionBar + Chat)
• Stun / freeze lock protection

📊 Player Feedback
Real-time cooldown display:
RC: Ready | LC: 3s | ULT: 17s

⚙️ Backend Features
• Automatic TIP assignment
• Ability handling & cancellation
• PvP damage control
• Inventory & potion management
• Data saved after restart
• Fully expandable system

🚀 Perfect For
• SMP servers
• PvP content creators
• YouTube / cinematic SMPs
• Competitive ability-based gameplay

🇩🇲 Commands TIPs

• /tip <arg> <player> <tip>
• /mytip
